title: Final Project

fields.label: Anything you want your coach to know?

instructions_html:
Final Project

For this project you will create a full, working chess game using Pygame. I have provided assets for each of the pieces so you can use them. Finish the pieces_dict file to place all the pieces. Write the game code in the project.py. If you have any questions, ask the Tech Coach. Good luck!

Hand it in

  1. Download the starter files from this page and unzip them into a new folder.
  2. Make a new repository on GitHub and push your folder to it. (GitHub Basics, the first exercise in Python I, walks through this.)
  3. Submit the link to your repository with the form below.
